title: Temporarily run quality checks on Python 3.11
description: As a maintainer of the private repository, I want quality checks to run only on production Python 3.11 and only for pull requests targeting main, while retaining the full matrix configuration for restoration when the repository is public again. Pushes to main remain enabled for post-merge semantic release.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Work started. The active quality-check matrix will be reduced to production Python 3.11. The original 3.10/3.11/3.12 matrix will remain documented inline for easy restoration when public-repository Actions capacity returns.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented the workflow change: the active quality-check matrix is Python 3.11 only; the previous 3.10/3.11/3.12 matrix is retained as an inline restoration instruction. The MCP-fixture and Black checks now run once on 3.11 so those checks remain covered during the temporary reduction. YAML parsing and matrix assertion passed.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Scope updated: quality checks should no longer run for every branch. The workflow will validate pull requests targeting main, plus main pushes required for the existing semantic-release job after merges. This removes branch-push and non-main-PR test runs without disabling releases.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Validation complete: release workflow YAML parsed successfully; assertions confirmed main-only push/PR triggers, the Python 3.11 matrix, and the semantic-release guard. Ruff, Black, ./test-ci.sh, and behave --tags=-skip all passed locally.
